'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Justin Desai DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title 10 Less Force 100% More Beats. Objective from senate package (sheet line 1 OCR garbled). Pasqual Yesser → [[Baskol Yeesrim]]; Yoh Yeh → [[Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn]]; Myth hunter → [[Mist Hunter (V)]]; ashley×3 → [[Ability, Ability, Ability]]; Trenchant tactics → [[Trenchant Insight (V)]] (may redlink); Admiral → [[Admiral Piett]]; Musik (V)/Hands Down (V) as written (may redlink).
